name: Scrabble Score
blurb: Given a word, compute the Scrabble score for that word.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to compute a word's Scrabble score by summing the values of its letters.

The letters are valued as follows:

| Letter                       | Value |
| ---------------------------- | ----- |
| A, E, I, O, U, L, N, R, S, T | 1     |
| D, G                         | 2     |
| B, C, M, P                   | 3     |
| F, H, V, W, Y                | 4     |
| K                            | 5     |
| J, X                         | 8     |
| Q, Z                         | 10    |

For example, the word "cabbage" is worth 14 points:

- 3 points for C
- 1 point for A
- 3 points for B
- 3 points for B
- 1 point for A
- 2 points for G
- 1 point for E
introduction:
# Introduction

[Scrabble][wikipedia] is a word game where players place letter tiles on a board to form words.
Each letter has a value.
A word's score is the sum of its letters' values.

[wikipedia]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scrabble

example_solution:
defmodule Scrabble do
  def score(word) do
    word |> letters |> summarize
  end

  defp letters(word), do: word |> String.trim() |> String.downcase() |> String.codepoints()

  defp summarize(letters),
    do: Enum.reduce(letters, 0, fn letter, acc -> acc + letter_score(letter) end)

  @letter_scores [
    {"aeilnorstu", 1},
    {"dg", 2},
    {"bcmp", 3},
    {"fhvwy", 4},
    {"k", 5},
    {"jx", 8},
    {"qz", 10}
  ]

  defp letter_score(letter) do
    Enum.find_value(@letter_scores, 0, fn {letters, score} ->
      String.contains?(letters, letter) && score
    end)
  end
end
